description: This file manages gateway credentials, including types, error handling, and functions to resolve credentials from various sources such as environment variables, configuration, and secret references. It also defines classes and functions for credential validation and error handling related to gateway secret references.

classes.name: GatewaySecretRefUnavailableError
classes.description: Custom error class indicating a secret reference is unavailable in the command path.

methods.name: isGatewaySecretRefUnavailableError
methods.description: Type guard function to check if an error is a GatewaySecretRefUnavailableError and optionally matches a specific path.

methods.name: resolveGatewayCredentialsFromValues
methods.description: Resolves gateway credentials (token and password) from provided values, environment variables, and precedence rules.

methods.name: resolveLocalGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Resolves local gateway credentials based on a credential plan, environment, and precedence rules.

methods.name: resolveRemoteGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Resolves remote gateway credentials based on a credential plan, precedence, and fallback rules.

methods.name: resolveGatewayCredentialsFromConfig
methods.description: Main function to resolve gateway credentials from configuration, environment, explicit auth, and override options.

methods.name: resolveGatewayProbeCredentialsFromConfig
methods.description: Resolves credentials specifically for gateway probe operations, with remote-only fallback.

methods.name: resolveGatewayDriftCheckCredentialsFromConfig
methods.description: Resolves credentials for gateway drift checks, using local credentials with config-first precedence.
